item.title: Giant’s Causeway celebrated in new UK passport design issued from today
item.description: The new British passport design, issued from today, showcases iconic landscapes including the Giant’s Causeway and features His Majesty King Charles III’s Coat of Arms alongside advanced anti-forgery technology.

item.title: Spending on agency nursing and care staff falls by £120m since 2023
item.description: Northern Ireland’s HSC has cut off-contract agency nursing and care staff spending by £120m since 2023, following the rollout of a new workforce framework.

item.title: King Kain crowned WKO Grand Champion after outstanding 2025 season
item.description: Ballymena’s 10-year-old talent King Kain Stewart has been crowned WKO Grand Champion following an exceptional 2025 season, earning top honours in K1 and Boxing and securing the coveted Favourite Fighter Award.

item.title: Primark Ballymena opens this week: New 29,000 sq. ft store marks major boost for Fairhill and local retail
item.description: Primark opens its brand-new 29,000 sq. ft store at Fairhill Shopping Centre in Ballymena this Friday, creating 70 new jobs and marking a major moment in the town’s retail revival. Here’s what shoppers can expect on opening day.

item.title: Large disparities emerge in Mid and East Antrim councillor expenses as allowances rise to £18,916
item.description: A full breakdown of Mid and East Antrim councillor expenses for 2024–25 reveals major differences between elected members, alongside a 3.2% rise in the basic allowance to £18,916. Includes highest and lowest claimants and public concerns over ratepayer value.

item.title: Unionists launch emergency High Court action against Belfast City Council over Palestinian flag vote
item.description: Unionist councillors are taking Belfast City Council to the High Court after a dramatic late-night vote approved flying the Palestinian flag over City Hall. Here’s what happened, the legal arguments involved, and what comes next.

item.title: Translink encourages shoppers to make Christmas travel easy with Park and Ride
item.description: Translink is urging Christmas shoppers to avoid festive congestion by using its Park and Ride sites across Northern Ireland, with extended opening hours, frequent services, contactless payments, and real-time travel tools.

item.title: PSNI opens criminal investigation after armed group issues threats to councillors and MLAs
item.description: PSNI launches a criminal investigation after masked, armed men—claiming to represent the New Republican Movement—issue threats to elected representatives in Newry, Mourne and Down. Superintendent Lynne Corbett condemns the intimidation.

item.title: Coca-Cola marks 17 years of rewarding designated drivers across Northern Ireland this Christmas
item.description: Coca-Cola Ireland has launched its 2025 Designated Driver campaign, marking 17 years of offering free soft drinks to designated drivers across Northern Ireland. Learn about participating venues, festive giveaways and Coca-Cola’s sustainability commitments.

item.title: North Ballymena Rangers FC secures 25-year lease for Smithfield Playing Field, marking ‘new era’ for the club
item.description: North Ballymena Rangers FC has secured a 25-year lease for Smithfield Playing Field, marking a major new chapter for the club. The decision, approved by Mid and East Antrim Borough Council, paves the way for future development and expanded community football provision.
